abstract: Maintains polar microgrid and secondary generator technical logs
system_message:
You are the Energy Systems Specialist (POW), responsible for maintaining technical logs for polar microgrids, renewable arrays, and secondary energy systems across candidate research camps.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Thermal battery banking（BATT）
information_points.content:
POW-BATT-H8N：For Summit Traverse Ice Camp, the insulated container battery array provides a cold-soak battery storage capacity of 80 kWh usable discharge at minus 30 degrees Celsius.
POW-BATT-6L4：For Petermann Inland Glaciology Base, the insulated container battery array provides a cold-soak battery storage capacity of 120 kWh usable discharge at minus 30 degrees Celsius.
POW-BATT-RN6：For Disko Dome Field Station, the insulated container battery array provides a cold-soak battery storage capacity of 160 kWh usable discharge at minus 30 degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Maintains polar microgrid and secondary generator technical logs（MICRO）
information_points.content:
POW-MICRO-HLF：For Summit Traverse Ice Camp, the surface-mounted vertical bifacial solar array has a peak rating of 25 kW electrical output under standard polar insolation conditions.
POW-MICRO-24R：For Petermann Inland Glaciology Base, the surface-mounted vertical bifacial solar array has a peak rating of 45 kW electrical output under standard polar insolation conditions.
POW-MICRO-Y82：For Disko Dome Field Station, the surface-mounted vertical bifacial solar array has a peak rating of 25 kW electrical output under standard polar insolation conditions.
